Norway proposes temporary ban on AI smart glasses

Norway is planning to introduce a temporary ban on smart glasses, specifically mentioning Meta's camera-enabled spectacles, in public spaces due to privacy concerns. The government is preparing a bill to implement this restriction. These devices have already faced limitations in the UK and US because of fears about covert recording.
